source.quote_free_summary: The chief judge must review all finalists before posting or starting finals; the event director and/or chief judge verify results. Neither is a scoring or tabulation function.

requirement: Chief judge and event director may review and verify without being blocked as scorers; finalist review recorded before finals start.
enforcement_point: Planned (design: docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6A): database triggers on officials, designations and result versions. Not built.
interpretation_notes: No finalist-review step exists today. Whether it is a hard start blocker is an open question (Q8). Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed. Applies only to WSDC-declared events; never imposed on NDCA, UCWDC or Studio/Custom.
